newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka NDB offers shares in local market.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka NDB offers shares in local market.

text.p: Sri Lankan blue chip National Development Bank Ltd (NDB) on Tuesday began taking applications from local investors for 900,000 of its 18.33 million share flotation.
The initial public offering (IPO), at a price of 250 rupees per share, will be officially launched on August 28.

The basis of allotment of the shares will be decided by the government and the Colombo Stock Exchange and will look to benefit the small investor, Ranjith Fernando, the bank's chief executive officer told a news conference.
The government converted 27.5 million NDB debentures to 18.33 million shares under an early conversion agreement and offered 16.5 million shares to foreign investors at 260 rupees per share.
